tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_vulnerability
tools.description: Retrieve details for a CVE or vulnerability ID from OSV, CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS, and NVD. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/cybersecurity-intelligence/vulnerability Keywords: CVE lookup, CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS, OSV, CVSS, known exploited, ransomware, affected packages, dependency risk, vulnerabili

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_package-check
tools.description: Check one package and version for vulnerabilities using OSV, enriched with CISA KEV, EPSS, and NVD data. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/cybersecurity-intelligence/package-check Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, vuln lookup, advisory, CVSS, package audit, lockfile au

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_package-batch-check
tools.description: Check multiple packages and versions for vulnerabilities using OSV batch query, enriched with CISA KEV, EPSS, and NVD data. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/cybersecurity-intelligence/package-batch-check Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, vuln lookup, advisory, CVSS, p

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_risk-assess
tools.description: Produce a consolidated vulnerability risk assessment for multiple packages, combining OSV, CISA KEV, EPSS, and NVD data. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/cybersecurity-intelligence/risk-assess Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, vuln lookup, advisory, CVSS, package audi

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_dependency-tree
tools.description: Return direct and transitive dependencies, dependency versions and available dependency metadata using Google deps.dev API. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/cybersecurity-intelligence/dependency-tree Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, vuln lookup, advisory, CVSS, packa

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_package-project-health
tools.description: Return project activity indicators, repository associations, package metadata and available security information using Google deps.dev API. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/cybersecurity-intelligence/package-project-health Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, vuln lookup

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_repository-scorecard
tools.description: Retrieve the official OpenSSF Scorecard result for a GitHub, GitLab or other supported repository. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/cybersecurity-intelligence/repository-scorecard Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, vuln lookup, advisory, CVSS, package audit, lockfile a

tools.name: cybersecurity-intelligence_lockfile-audit
tools.description: Parse supported package lockfiles, identify dependencies and versions, then combine deps.dev and existing OSV/CISA/EPSS/NVD findings. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/cybersecurity-intelligence/lockfile-audit Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, vuln lookup, advisory, CV

tools.name: contact_us
tools.description: How to contact BRAINIAC.software support: email, page URL, what to include in a message, and what not to send. Free. Does not send email.
